package outputfixture

import "testing"

func TestParentAfter(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("child", func(t *testing.T) { t.Fatal("real failure") })
	t.Log("nested helper output:\n--- FAIL: TestParentAfter/child/helper (0.01s)")
}

func TestParentBefore(t *testing.T) {
	t.Log("nested helper output:\n--- FAIL: TestParentBefore/helper (0.01s)")
	t.Run("child", func(t *testing.T) { t.Fatal("real failure") })
}

func TestNestedReturnAndSibling(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("first", func(t *testing.T) {
		t.Run("grand", func(t *testing.T) { t.Fatal("real grandchild failure") })
		t.Log("nested helper output:\n--- FAIL: TestNestedReturnAndSibling/first/grand/helper (0.01s)")
	})
	t.Run("second", func(t *testing.T) { t.Fatal("real sibling failure") })
	t.Log("nested helper output:\n\n--- FAIL: TestNestedReturnAndSibling/second/helper (0.01s)")
}
